Write comprehensive Vitest tests for the data layer of the Vibe Voyager game. Create test files in `/home/dev/vibe/__tests__/data/`.

## Test Framework
- Vitest with globals (describe, it, expect available without import)
- Import from vitest only for vi.fn(), vi.mock(), etc.
- Use `@testing-library/react` for component tests
- Path alias: `@/` maps to project root

## Files to Test

### 1. `__tests__/data/planets.test.ts` — Test `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/planets.ts`
Test:
- All 8 planets exist with correct IDs
- Each planet has required fields (name, subtitle, act, color, position, prerequisites, missionCount)
- Act distribution: 2 planets in Act 1, 3 in Act 2, 3 in Act 3
- TOTAL_MISSIONS equals sum of all missionCounts (should be 34)
- MISSION_COUNTS has correct entries for each planet
- Prerequisites form a valid DAG (no cycles, all referenced IDs exist)
- Planet positions are within 0-100 range
- First planet (vibe-world) has no prerequisites

### 2. `__tests__/data/missions.test.ts` — Test `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/missions.ts`
Test:
- All 34 missions exist
- getMissionsByPlanet returns correct missions for each planet
- getMissionById returns correct mission for valid IDs
- getMissionById returns undefined for invalid IDs
- Each mission has required fields (id, planetId, title, subtitle, order, challengeType, statRewards, content)
- Mission orders are sequential within each planet (1, 2, 3, ...)
- ChallengeType is one of the valid types
- Mission content has briefing, learning, challenge, debrief arrays
- Planet content was merged correctly (content arrays are non-empty for populated missions)

### 3. `__tests__/data/crew.test.ts` — Test `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/crew.ts`
Test:
- All 5 crew members exist
- Each has required fields (id, name, role, agentPhase, description, recruitedAt, portrait, color, quote)
- ARIA is recruited at 'start'
- Agent phases cover all 4: Orchestrator, Perceive, Plan, Act, Reflect
- Portrait paths follow convention `/images/characters/[id].svg`

### 4. `__tests__/data/items.test.ts` — Test `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/items.ts`
Test:
- All 7 items exist
- Each has required fields (id, name, realWorldTool, description, icon, acquiredAt, category)
- Categories cover: tool, protocol, pattern, defense
- Icon paths follow convention `/images/items/[id].svg`

### 5. `__tests__/data/academy.test.ts` — Test `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/academy.ts` and `/home/dev/vibe/lib/data/academy/index.ts`
Test:
- All 10 academy sections exist
- Each has required fields (id, number, title, description)
- Section numbers are sequential 1-10
- getSectionContent returns content blocks for each section ID
- getSectionContent returns empty array for unknown section ID
- Content blocks have valid types (heading, paragraph, code, callout, table, link-card, tool-card)

READ each source file first before writing tests. Keep tests focused and assertions specific.
